list.text: \f[facerival]\b...Oh, it's you.
\f[facerival]\bYou must be here to catch the legendary Pokémon to make yourself look strong.
\f[facerival]\bThat is only a dream.
\f[facerival]\bYou see, the legendary Pokémon suits a Trainer like me who has sworn to become the strongest Trainer.
\f[facerival]\bA battle with Team Rocket Grunts is just right for you!

Don't worry!\nWe fire-breathers know the true power of fire better than anyone!
The reason this tower's burned is that it was hit by lightning.
The fire I'm breathing is tiny in comparison...
I'm practing my fire breathing in the Burned Tower! Don't try this at home!
Oops, please don't misunderstand! I'm not the reason that this tower is burned up!
\f[morty]\bMy name is Morty.\nI am Ecruteak's Gym Leader.
\f[morty]\bBecause my old friend Eusine is here on the trail of SUICUNE, I decided to investigate the Burned Tower.
\f[morty]\bEcruteak has a legend about these legendary Pokémon: SUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU.
\f[morty]\bAs the Gym Leader of Ecruteak, I must have a proper understanding of it.
\f[faceEusine]\bMy name is Eusine.\nI'm on the trail of a Pokémon named SUICUNE.
\f[faceEusine]\bAnd you are...?
\f[faceEusine]\b\PN?\nGlad to meet you!
\f[faceEusine]\bI heard rumors that SUICUNE is here, so I came to look.
\f[faceEusine]\bBut where exactly it should be?
\f[faceEusine]\bI could go downstairs, but I know it would run away in no time.
\f[faceEusine]\bI know.\nI have tried it many times...
